section.name: WhatIsManagedMLflow
section.layout_description: Single column text block. Recommended characters per line for text: ~80-100

content.text:
Managed MLflow on Databricks delivers state-of-the-art experiment tracking, observability, performance evaluation, and model management for the full spectrum of machine learning and AI, from classical models and deep learning to generative AI applications and agents, all on the Databricks lakehouse. MLflow's unified AI and ML platform eliminates the need to manage and integrate separate, specialized platforms for your generative AI initiatives and your classical machine learning or deep learning workflows. Managed MLflow is built on the flexible foundation of open-source MLflow and fortified with enterprise-grade reliability, security, and scalability. This empowers you to confidently build high quality models and agents using your preferred tools from the entire AI/ML ecosystem, all while ensuring your AI data is protected.
Get started with Managed MLflow for free, in less than five minutes.

content.text: Ship high-quality generative AI apps & agents, fast

Managed MLflow accelerates your path to production for generative AI applications and agents, while helping you achieve top-notch performance. From initial debugging with powerful tracing capabilities and robust prompt management for reproducible experimentation, to comprehensive evaluation using LLM-assisted and human feedback, and finally, confident deployment and monitoring with deep observability—MLflow provides the end-to-end tools you need to succeed with generative AI.

image.alt: Advanced Generative AI Observability placeholder image

text_group.text: Comprehensive AI Observability with Tracing and Real-time Monitoring

Debug and iterate on your generative AI applications effortlessly—both in development and production—by leveraging end-to-end tracing that captures crucial details like prompts, retrievals, and tool calls. Maintain high standards in production with continuous online quality monitoring. Gain real-time visibility with rich dashboards and detailed trace explorers in MLflow's powerful observability UI. Configure automated LLM-as-a-judge alerts to swiftly identify and address issues.

image.alt: Advanced Generative AI Evaluation placeholder image

text_group.text: Intelligent Evaluations for Enhanced AI Quality

Systematically evaluate and enhance application performance with MLflow's suite of generative AI evaluation capabilities. MLflow makes generative AI evaluation intuitive, allowing you to easily collect and record LLM judge and human feedback directly on traces. Further refine your applications by creating evaluation datasets from production logs to adapt to evolving user behavior. With Managed MLflow, you gain access to hosted LLM judges with industry-leading quality, which can be easily tuned and customized according to your use cases.

image.alt: Prompt Engineering and Management placeholder image

text_group.text: Prompt Management and Agent Versioning

Effectively manage the complete lifecycle of your generative AI applications, from individual prompts to entire agents. Developers can version, compare, iterate on, and discover prompt templates directly through the MLflow UI. Beyond prompts, MLflow enables holistic versioning of your agents, capturing their associated code, parameters, and performance metrics for each iteration. Reuse prompts across multiple versions of your agent or application code, and view rich lineage identifying which versions are using each prompt. This centralized management of both prompts and agents complements Git, providing full lifecycle capabilities for all your generative AI assets. This ensures that evaluation and observability data are linked to specific prompt and agent/application versions for better governance and reproducibility.

content.text: Build and deploy powerful ML & DL models at scale

text_group.text: Comprehensive Experiment Tracking

Run experiments with any ML library, framework, or language. Automatically track parameters, metrics, code, and models from each run. Securely share, manage, and compare experiment results along with corresponding artifacts and code versions, thanks to built-in integrations with the Databricks workspace and notebooks. Managed MLflow allows streamlined comparison and management of deep learning checkpoints, each tracked as an MLflow Logged Model with its own metrics and artifacts for clear lineage.
Streamlined Model Management & Governance

Utilize one central place, the MLflow Model Registry (integrated with Unity Catalog on Databricks), to discover, share, and manage all your ML models. Collaborate on moving them from experimentation to production, integrate with approval and governance workflows and CI/CD pipelines, and monitor deployments. Managed MLflow provides enhanced performance lineage across environments, so metrics are visible across workspaces as models are promoted, ensuring robust governance.
Flexible and Scalable Deployment

Quickly deploy production models for batch inference on Apache Spark™ or as REST APIs using built-in integrations. With Managed MLflow on Databricks, operationalize and monitor production models using Databricks Model Serving for massive scale. MLflow's industry-leading packaging for classical and deep learning models includes weights, code, and software dependencies, ensuring seamless deployment. Orchestrate evaluation and production deployment from a centralized UI with UC Model Registry Deployment Jobs.

text_group.text: Unified, End-to-End MLOps and AI Observability

Streamline your AI and ML workflows with a cohesive platform that standardizes the entire development and deployment lifecycle for your cutting-edge generative AI applications and machine learning models. MLflow provides robust support for generative AI tracing, prompt management, rich LLM-as-a-judge evaluations, and continuous AI quality monitoring for production deployments. For classical ML, MLflow offers comprehensive experiment tracking, model packaging, collaborative model management, and deployment solutions for batch and real-time inference. This unified platform delivers a consistent, simplified experience, accelerating collaboration and innovation by removing the friction of integrating multiple tools.

image.alt: Enterprise Security and Governance on Databricks platform placeholder image

text_group.text: Enterprise-Grade Security & Governance on a Unified Data & AI Platform

As a core component of the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, Managed MLflow provides more than just MLOps; it's your gateway to a comprehensive AI development experience. Deep integrations with the broader Mosaic AI product suite enable you to build high-quality training datasets with consistent, reusable features from Feature Store, accelerate model development with robust AI finetuning and AutoML capabilities, build powerful RAG applications using Vector Search, productionize any model with scalable Model Serving, and secure your generative AI deployments with AI Gateway. All of this is underpinned by Databricks Unity Catalog, giving you centralized governance over every AI asset—from data and models to agents and applications—ensuring compliance and control as you innovate.

image.alt: Open and Extensible Ecosystem placeholder image

text_group.text: Open, Flexible, and Extensible

Maintain agility and avoid being locked into a narrow set of tools. MLflow's open-source core and extensible architecture allow you to use your preferred frameworks, libraries, and languages. Managed MLflow seamlessly integrates with a rich ecosystem of data sources, ML / AI tools, and deployment solutions. This flexibility ensures that Managed MLflow can adapt to your existing stack and evolve with your future needs, supporting innovation across your entire AI portfolio.
